elements.name: Feyblood
elements.desc: The elves of Silfast deem themselves fortunate to have those known as the Feyblood as their neighbors. It is even rumored that they can resist the effects...

elements.name: Fey Ancestry
elements.desc: You have advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can’t put you to sleep.

elements.name: Fey Charm
elements.desc: You can target one humanoid or beast that you can see within 30 feet. It must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be magically charmed. The charmed creature regards you as a trusted friend to be heeded and protected. Although the target isn’t under your control, it takes your requests or actions in the most favorable way it can.

elements.name: Fey Resistance
elements.desc: You have advantage on saving throws against being charmed and against illusion magic.

elements.name: Sylphi
elements.desc: As a skyborn feyblood, you inherited the powers of the faeries who dwell in the eternal skies. You take great pride in your heritage, and have a keen sense...

elements.name: Faerie Wings
elements.desc: At 3rd level, you can use your wings to glide at a rate of 60 feet per round as if under the effects of a feather fall spell. At 6th level, once per long rest, you can fly as if under the effect of the fly spell for up to 10 minutes.

elements.name: Dryashi
elements.desc: You have a spiritual connection with the land and sea. With such a strong bond, you feel a sense of kinship with all living creatures. You tend to be...

elements.name: Earthen Upbringing
elements.desc: While perfectly still, you are invisible when you are only lightly obscured by foliage, heavy rain, falling snow, mist, and other natural phenomena. At 6th level, when you are hidden in this way, you can use your action to cast invisibility with no material components, and you can’t use this feature again until you finish a long rest.
